repo_notes.content: tmrw-platform is a full-stack athlete NIL and local sponsorship marketplace. src/ contains the Vite + React frontend, src/data/roster.ts holds static fallback contender data, and server/index.js runs the Express API handling Stripe Connect 70/15/15 escrow splits, Supabase PostGIS spatial queries, and TwelveLabs media modals.

pages.title: Frontend & Awwwards UI Architecture
pages.purpose: Document src/ components, AthleteDossierDrawer, SponsorDrawer, MapView, and strict #080808/#F7F7F6/#B8FF00 styling rules.

pages.title: Backend API, Stripe Escrow & PostGIS Fallbacks
pages.purpose: Document server/index.js, src/api.ts, CommercialLedger 70/15/15 split and 10% GST/RCTI math, and static fallback behaviour when Supabase or TwelveLabs times out.
